definitions.explanation: A formal noun expressing gratitude for another's thoughtfulness or support. Almost always appears with the honorific prefix ご and is restricted to business correspondence and formal speeches.

examples.japanese: ご{高配|こうはい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{賜|たまわ}る→賜る：07659_tamawaru⟧。

{平素|へいそ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{高配|こうはい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{賜|たまわ}り→賜る：07659_tamawaru⟧、⟦{誠|まこと}→誠：27623_makoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: We sincerely thank you for your special patronage as always.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{変|か}わらぬ→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ご{高配|こうはい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほど、⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: We humbly ask for your continued patronage going forward.

notes:
A set formal noun used almost exclusively in written business correspondence and ceremonial speeches. Always takes the honorific ご and is paired with verbs of receiving such as ⟦{賜|たまわ}る→賜る：07659_tamawaru⟧ or ⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{高配|こうはい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{賜|たまわ}る→賜る：07659_tamawaru⟧: to receive your kind consideration
- ⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{高配|こうはい}: your exceptional patronage
- ⟦{変|か}わらぬ→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ご{高配|こうはい}: your unchanging patronage
- ご{高配|こうはい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほど: (a softener closing the phrase)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ご{愛顧|あいこ}: your patronage — used by businesses thanking customers
- ご{厚情|こうじょう}: your warm-hearted favor — slightly warmer in tone, used for personal gratitude
- お⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}て→引き立てる：12585_hikitateru⟧: your support — slightly less stiff but similarly formal
